# Original Intake Decision

This older decision is the first member of a fabricated supersedence chain. It was created on 2025-12-01T08:00:00Z by agent:alice and assigned the decision identifier `dec-001`.

The decision said that every note in the vault should be manually tagged before review. That guidance was simple, but it placed too much work on the intake step and encouraged reviewers to invent overlapping labels. The later decision `dec-002` replaced this rule with a controlled vocabulary proposal.

This file is intentionally marked `head: false` because it is no longer the current instruction. It remains in the vault so chain traversal can confirm that an older decision was superseded rather than deleted.

## Historical Context

The synthetic team wanted a rule that would make notes easy to search. Manual tagging seemed adequate when the vault was tiny, but it did not scale across commitments, transcripts, proposals, and concept notes.

No production system is referenced in this note. The only purpose is to provide a stable predecessor for supersedence tests and to make `dec-002` meaningful as the middle decision in the chain.

## Supersedence Role

This note should be treated as replaced, not missing. Removing it would make the chain shorter and would reduce the value of the stale-head fixture. Keeping it with `head: false` gives tests a concrete older rule to discover.
